source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 15 (PDF 323-335), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Basic Separation Techniques) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Analytical chemistry is the science of:
(Analytical chemistry kis cheez ki science hai?)
blocks.explanation: Analytical chemistry chemical characterization (kimiyai pehchaan) ki science hai.

book_ref.quote: Analytical chemistry is the science of chemical characterization.

blocks.prompt:
2 In qualitative analysis the chemist is concerned with:
(Qualitative analysis mein chemist ka kaam kya hota hai?)

options.text: the relative amounts of elements in a compound
detection or identification of the elements present in a compound
the heat given out in a reaction

blocks.explanation: Qualitative analysis mein compound mein maujood elements ki pehchaan hoti hai; un ki miqdaar quantitative analysis mein maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: the chemist is concerned with the detection or identification of the elements present in a compound

blocks.prompt:
3 Finding the relative amounts of elements in a compound is called:
(Compound mein elements ki nisbati miqdaar maloom karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Quantitative analysis (miqdaari tajziya) mein elements ki nisbati miqdaar maloom ki jati hai.

book_ref.quote: in quantitative analysis, the relative amounts of elements in compounds are determined

blocks.prompt:
4 A complete quantitative determination generally consists of how many major steps?
(Mukammal quantitative determination aam tor par kitne bare steps par mushtamil hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sample lena, matloob juz ki alehdgi, measurement aur hisaab, aur nateeja nikaalna: chaar steps.

book_ref.quote: A complete quantitative determination generally consists of four major steps

blocks.prompt:
5 Which of these is the second major step of a complete quantitative determination?
(Mukammal quantitative determination ka doosra bara step kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tarteeb: sample lena, matloob juz alag karna, measurement aur hisaab, phir nateeja.

book_ref.quote: Separation of the desired constituent

blocks.prompt:
6 The methods of filtration, crystallization, distillation and paper chromatography separate the components of a mixture by:
(Filtration, crystallization, distillation aur paper chromatography mixture ke ajza ko kis tareeqe se alag karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mixture ke ajza in physical methods (tabai tareeqon) se alag kiye ja sakte hain (15.1).

book_ref.quote: The components of a mixture can be separated by any of the following physical methods.

blocks.prompt:
7 To separate a two-component mixture by filtration, the first step is to:
(Do ajza wale mixture ko filtration se alag karne ka pehla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: heat the mixture to its boiling point
select a solvent in which one component dissolves and the other remains practically insoluble
dry the mixture in a desiccator

blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam aisa solvent chunna hai jis mein aik juz poora hal ho jaye aur doosra taqreeban hal na ho.

book_ref.quote: The first step is to select a suitable solvent in which one of the components dissolves completely

blocks.prompt:
8 In a solution of common salt in water, the solvent is the component that is:
(Namak aur paani ke solution mein solvent woh juz hai jo:)

options.text: present in excess as compared to the solute

blocks.explanation: Solvent woh juz hai jo solute se zyada miqdaar mein ho; yahan paani solvent hai.

book_ref.quote: In a solution, the solvent is that component which is present in excess as compared to the solute.

blocks.prompt:
9 When a mixture of common salt and sand is put in distilled water, the salt and water form a:
(Namak aur rait ka mixture distilled paani mein daalne par namak aur paani kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Namak poore paani mein phail kar homogeneous mixture (yaksaan amaizah), yani solution banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The common salt will distribute itself through out water to give a homogeneous mixture.

blocks.prompt:
10 The filter medium to be used is decided mainly by:
(Kaun sa filter medium istemal ho, yeh zyada tar kis baat se tay hota hai?)

options.text: the boiling point of the filtrate

blocks.explanation: Precipitate (tah-nasheen) ki nauiyat aur kuch aur cheezein tay karti hain ke kaun sa filter medium ho.

book_ref.quote: Nature of the precipitate and other factors dictate which filter medium must be used.

blocks.prompt:
11 Filtration through a glass funnel and an ordinary filter paper is usually:
(Glass funnel aur aam filter paper se filtration aam tor par kaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glass funnel aur filter paper se filtration aam tor par sust (slow) amal hai.

book_ref.quote: Filtration by a glass funnel and filter paper is usually a slow process.

blocks.prompt:
12 The pore size of the filter paper to be used depends upon:
(Filter paper ke pore size ka intikhaab kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: the size of particles in the precipitate

blocks.explanation: Filter paper mukhtalif porosity (masaamon ka size) mein milte hain; intikhaab precipitate ke zarraat ke size par hai.

book_ref.quote: Which pore size is to be used, depends upon the size of particles in the precipitate.

blocks.prompt:
13 The filter paper should be large enough that at the end of filtration it is filled with precipitate to about:
(Filter paper itna bara ho ke filtration ke aakhir mein us mein precipitate kitna bhara ho?)
blocks.explanation: Filtration ke aakhir mein paper chauthai se aadha precipitate se bhara hona chahiye.

book_ref.quote: it is one-fourth to one-half full of precipitate at the end of filtration

blocks.prompt:
14 The folded filter paper is inserted into a funnel of angle:
(Tah kiya hua filter paper kitne degree ke funnel mein rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tah kiya paper 60-degree funnel mein rakh kar paani se geela aur dabaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The folded filter paper may then be inserted into 60-degree funnel

blocks.prompt:
15 The rate of filtration through a conical funnel can be considerably increased by using:
(Conical funnel se filtration ki raftaar kis cheez se kaafi barhai ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fluted filter paper (pankhe jaisi tah wala paper) filtration ki raftaar kaafi barha deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The rate of filtration through conical funnel can be considerably increased using a Fluted Filter Paper

blocks.prompt:
16 A fluted filter paper is folded so that it has:
(Fluted filter paper kis tarah tah kiya jata hai?)

options.text: a fan-like arrangement with alternate elevations and depressions

blocks.explanation: Fluting se pankhe jaisi shakal banti hai jis mein baari baari ubhaar aur gehraiyan hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: a fan like arrangement with alternate elevations and depressions at various folds is obtained

blocks.prompt:
17 After filtration, the liquid collected in the flask under the funnel is called the:
(Filtration ke baad funnel ke neeche flask mein jama hone wala liquid kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Funnel ke neeche flask mein aane wala liquid filtrate kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: the liquid which is obtained in the conical flask underneath the funnel is called the filtrate

blocks.prompt:
18 In the filtration of a salt-sand mixture, the sand left on the filter paper is called the:
(Namak-rait mixture ki filtration mein filter paper par bachi rait kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Funnel par bachi rait residue kehlati hai.

book_ref.quote: The sand left behind on the funnel is called the residue.

blocks.prompt:
19 Filtration through a crucible is usually done by:
(Crucible se filtration aam tor par kis tareeqe se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Crucible se precipitate suction (khinchaao) ke zariye filter kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Another convenient way to filter a precipitate is by suction through a crucible.

blocks.prompt:
20 A Gooch crucible is made of:
(Gooch crucible kis cheez ka bana hota hai?)

options.text: glass, porous glass disc ke saath
copper, jaali wale pinde ke saath
plastic, filter paper cone ke saath
porcelain, surakhon wale pinde ke saath

blocks.explanation: Gooch crucible porcelain ka hota hai jis ka pinda (bottom) surakhon wala hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Gooch crucible is made of porcelain having a perforated bottom

blocks.prompt:
21 A Gooch crucible is particularly useful for precipitates that:
(Gooch crucible khaas tor par kin precipitates ke liye mufeed hai?)

options.text: need to be ignited at high temperature

blocks.explanation: Gooch crucible un precipitates ke liye mufeed hai jinhein zyada temperature par jalaana (ignite) ho.

book_ref.quote: It is useful for the filtration of precipitates, which need to be ignited at high temperature.

blocks.prompt:
22 To filter solutions that react with paper, such as concentrated HCl or KMnO₄, the perforations of a Gooch crucible are covered with:
(Paper se react karne wale solutions (maslan concentrated HCl ya KMnO₄) filter karne ke liye Gooch crucible ke surakh kis se dhaanpe jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Asbestos mat lagane se Gooch crucible paper se react karne wale solutions (concentrated HCl, KMnO₄) filter kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: If its perforations are covered with asbestos mat

blocks.prompt:
23 A crucible with a porous glass disc sealed into its bottom is a:
(Jis crucible ke pinde mein porous glass disc band (seal) ho, woh kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sintered glass crucible ke pinde mein porous glass disc seal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Sintered glass crucible is a glass crucible with a porous glass disc sealed into the bottom.

blocks.prompt:
24 A sintered glass crucible is more convenient than a Gooch crucible because:
(Sintered glass crucible Gooch crucible se zyada aasaan kyun hai?)

options.text: it can be covered with paper pulp
it needs no preparation before use

blocks.explanation: Is ko istemal se pehle tayyar nahi karna parta, jab ke Gooch crucible ko karna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is very convenient to use because no preparation is needed as with the Gooch crucible

blocks.prompt:
25 The basic principle of crystallization is that the solute is soluble in a suitable solvent at high temperature and:
(Crystallization ka bunyadi usool yeh hai ke solute zyada temperature par solvent mein hal ho aur:)

options.text: the solute reacts with the solvent
the excess solute is thrown out as crystals on cooling

blocks.explanation: Garm solution thanda karne par zaid solute crystals ki shakal mein bahar aa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the excess amount of the solute is thrown out as crystals when it is cooled

blocks.prompt:
26 The first step of crystallization is to:
(Crystallization ka pehla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: dry the crystals in an oven
prepare a saturated solution of the substance in a suitable solvent

blocks.explanation: Pehle munasib solvent mein substance ka saturated (sair-shuda) solution banaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Prepare a saturated solutions of the substance in a suitable solvent

blocks.prompt:
27 The insoluble impurities are removed by filtering the saturated solution while it is hot because this:
(Ghair-hal-pazeer impurities garm saturated solution filter kar ke kyun nikali jati hain?)

options.text: avoids premature crystallization of the solute on the filter paper or funnel stem

blocks.explanation: Garm filter karne se solute filter paper ya funnel ki nali mein waqt se pehle crystals nahi banata.

book_ref.quote: The insoluble impurities in the saturated solution are then removed by filtering the hot saturated solution.

blocks.prompt:
28 The hot filtered solution is cooled at a moderate rate so that:
(Garm filter shuda solution darmiyani raftaar se kyun thanda kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyani raftaar se thanda karne par darmiyane size ke crystals bante hain.

book_ref.quote: The hot filtered solution is then cooled at a moderate rate so that medium sized crystals are formed.

blocks.prompt:
29 Coloured or resinous impurities in a crude substance are removed by boiling it in the solvent with:
(Crude substance ki rangdaar ya resinous impurities solvent mein kis cheez ke saath ubaal kar nikali jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Animal charcoal rangdaar impurities ko adsorb (satah par jazb) kar leta hai; saaf substance thanda hone par crystallize hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The coloured impurities are adsorbed by animal charcoal

blocks.prompt:
30 The mixture of crystals and mother liquor is filtered through a Gooch crucible with the help of a:
(Crystals aur mother liquor ka mixture Gooch crucible se kis cheez ki madad se filter kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Crystals aur mother liquor ko vacuum pump ke saath Gooch crucible se filter kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the mixture of crystals and the mother liquor is filtered through a Gooch crucible using a vacuum pump

blocks.prompt:
31 Crystals may be dried in an oven only if the substance:
(Crystals oven mein sirf tab sukhaaye ja sakte hain jab substance:)

options.text: is soluble in water at room temperature
does not melt or decompose on heating at 100 °C

blocks.explanation: Oven mein tabhi sukhaayein jab substance 100 °C par na pighle aur na toote (decompose).

book_ref.quote: provided the substance does not melt or decompose on heating at 100° C

blocks.prompt:
32 A safe and reliable method of drying crystals is to keep them, spread on a watch glass, in a:
(Crystals sukhaane ka mehfooz aur qabil-e-aitbaar tareeqa unhein watch glass par phaila kar kis mein rakhna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vacuum desiccator crystals sukhaane ka mehfooz aur qabil-e-aitbaar tareeqa hai.

book_ref.quote: A safe and reliable method of drying crystals is through a vacuum desiccator.

blocks.prompt:
33 Which of the following is NOT named as a drying agent in a desiccator?
(In mein se kaun sa desiccator ka drying agent nahi bataya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Drying agents CaCl₂, silica gel aur phosphorus pentaoxide hain; animal charcoal rangdaar impurities nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The drying agents used in a desiccator are CaCl₂, silica gel or phosphorus pentaoxide

blocks.prompt:
34 An ideal solvent for crystallization should dissolve:
(Crystallization ke liye behtareen solvent ko kaisa hona chahiye?)

options.text: a large amount of the substance at its boiling point and only a small amount at room temperature
a small amount at its boiling point and a large amount at room temperature
the same amount at all temperatures
the impurities as well as the substance at room temperature

blocks.explanation: Achha solvent apne boiling point par substance ki zyada miqdaar aur room temperature par kam miqdaar hal kare.

book_ref.quote: It should dissolve a large amount of the substance at its boiling point

blocks.prompt:
35 Which is a required feature of an ideal crystallization solvent?
(Crystallization ke achhe solvent ki zaroori khoobi kaun si hai?)

options.text: it should react with the solute
it should crystallize along with the impurities
it should not react chemically with the solute

blocks.explanation: Achha solvent solute se kimiyai amal nahi karta, aur sasta, mehfooz aur aasaani se door hone wala hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It should not react chemically with the solute.

blocks.prompt:
36 Crystals appearing during filtration can choke the filter paper or funnel. This is avoided by using a:
(Filtration ke dauran crystals filter paper ya funnel band kar sakte hain. Is se bachne ke liye kya istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hot water funnel (garm paani wala funnel) crystals ko filter band karne se rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: To avoid this a hot water funnel may be used.

blocks.prompt:
37 Which of these is NOT among the solvents mostly used for crystallization named in the chapter?
(Chapter mein crystallization ke aam solvents mein se kaun sa shaamil nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Aam solvents: paani, absolute ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride aur acetic acid.

book_ref.quote: The solvents which are mostly used for crystallization are

blocks.prompt:
38 If no single solvent is suitable for crystallization, one may use:
(Agar koi aik solvent crystallization ke liye munasib na ho to kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: a combination of two or more miscible solvents

blocks.explanation: Do ya zyada miscible (aapas mein mil jane wale) solvents mila kar istemal kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: a combination of two or more miscible solvents may be employed

blocks.prompt:
39 An inflammable solvent is heated on a:
(Aag pakarne wala (inflammable) solvent kis par garm kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inflammable solvent ko aag se bachane ke liye water bath par garm karte hain.

book_ref.quote: In such cases, water bath is used for heating purpose.

blocks.prompt:
40 A solution of a solid compound dissolved in water can be separated by:
(Paani mein hal shuda solid compound ka solution kis tareeqe se alag ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Solid ka solution simple distillation se alag kiya ja sakta hai (15.3).

book_ref.quote: then that mixture can be separated by simple distillation

blocks.prompt:
41 Sea water is made drinkable by distillation because it:
(Samandari paani ko distillation se peene ke qabil kyun banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samandari paani mein bohat se hal shuda inorganic compounds hain; distillation unhein door karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Sea water is not drinkable because it is a mixture of many soluble inorganic compounds in water.

blocks.prompt:
42 Fractional distillation is used to separate:
(Fractional distillation kis cheez ko alag karne ke liye hai?)

options.text: two liquids which are miscible with each other

blocks.explanation: Fractional distillation do aise liquids alag karti hai jo aapas mein mil jate (miscible) hain.

book_ref.quote: used to separate two liquids which are soluble or miscible with each other

blocks.prompt:
43 Boiling chips are added to the distillation flask to:
(Distillation flask mein boiling chips kyun daale jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Boiling chips liquid ke jhatke se uchhalne (bumping) ko rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: Add a few pieces of boiling chips to prevent bumping of the liquid in the flask.

blocks.prompt:
44 The distillation apparatus is made air tight to:
(Distillation apparatus ko air tight kyun kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Poora apparatus air tight karte hain taake vapours (bukhaarat) bahar na niklein.

book_ref.quote: Make whole apparatus air tight to prevent vapors to escape.

blocks.prompt:
45 In distillation, the condensed liquid collected in the receiving flask is called the:
(Distillation mein receiving flask mein jama hone wala condensed liquid kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Condenser mein dobara liquid bane vapours receiving flask mein distillate kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: This is called distillate and it will be collected in the receiving flask.

blocks.prompt:
46 The components left behind in the distillation flask are called the:
(Distillation flask mein peeche reh jane wale ajza kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Distillation flask mein bache ajza mil kar residue kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: The components left behind in the distillation flask are collectively called the residue.

blocks.prompt:
47 The distillation (fractionating) column is filled with glass beads to:
(Distillation column mein glass beads kyun bhare jate hain?)

options.text: increase the surface area available for condensing the vapour

blocks.explanation: Glass beads vapour ke condense hone ke liye surface area (satah ka raqba) barhaate hain.

book_ref.quote: The distillation column is filled with glass beads to increase the surface area

blocks.prompt:
48 When a mixture of ethyl alcohol and water is fractionally distilled, the thermometer stays at 78 °C while:
(Ethyl alcohol aur paani ke mixture ki fractional distillation mein thermometer 78 °C par kab tak rehta hai?)

options.text: ethyl alcohol is being distilled over

blocks.explanation: Ethyl alcohol (b.p. 78 °C) pehle distil hota hai; jab tak yeh distil ho, temperature 78 °C rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: its boiling point is 78 °C less than that of water whose boiling point is 100 °C

blocks.prompt:
49 In the fractional distillation of alcohol and water, the receiving flask is replaced when:
(Alcohol aur paani ki fractional distillation mein receiving flask kab badla jata hai?)

options.text: the first drop of distillate appears
the condenser water is turned off

blocks.explanation: Jaise hi temperature 78 °C se upar jane lage, receiving flask badal diya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: As soon as the temperature starts rising above 78 °C, replace the receiving flask with a new one

blocks.prompt:
50 Petrol, diesel, kerosene oil and furnace oil are separated from petroleum by:
(Petrol, diesel, kerosene aur furnace oil petroleum se kis tareeqe se alag kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ajza ke boiling points qareeb qareeb hain; yeh fractional distillation se alag kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: These components are separated as fractions by fractional distillation using a fractionating

blocks.prompt:
51 Chromatography involves the distribution of a solute between:
(Chromatography mein solute kin do cheezon ke darmiyan taqseem hota hai?)

options.text: a stationary phase and a mobile phase
a filter paper and a funnel

blocks.explanation: Chromatography mein solute stationary phase (thehra hua hissa) aur mobile phase (chalta hua hissa) mein taqseem hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It involves the distribution of a solute (mixture) between a stationary phase and a mobile phase.

blocks.prompt:
52 The mobile phase in chromatography may be:
(Chromatography mein mobile phase kya ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mobile phase gas ya liquid ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: The mobile phase flowing over the surface of the stationary phase may be a gas or a liquid.

blocks.prompt:
53 Chromatography in which the stationary phase is a solid is called:
(Jis chromatography mein stationary phase solid ho, woh kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Solid stationary phase wali chromatography adsorption chromatography kehlati hai.

book_ref.quote: Chromatography in which the stationary phase is a solid, is classified as adsorption chromatography.

blocks.prompt:
54 Which is an example of adsorption chromatography?
(Adsorption chromatography ki misaal kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: TLC aur column chromatography adsorption ki misalein hain; paper aur gas liquid chromatography partition ki.

book_ref.quote: Examples of adsorption chromatography are thin layer chromatography (TLC) and column chromatography.

blocks.prompt:
55 In partition chromatography the substances being separated are:
(Partition chromatography mein alag hone wale substances kahan hote hain?)

options.text: adsorbed only on a solid surface
held only in the mobile phase
distributed throughout both the stationary and mobile phases

blocks.explanation: Partition chromatography mein substances dono phases mein phaile hote hain; stationary phase liquid hota hai.

book_ref.quote: the substances being separated are distributed throughout both the stationary and mobile phases

blocks.prompt:
56 Gas liquid chromatography is an example of:
(Gas liquid chromatography kis qisam ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paper aur gas liquid chromatography partition chromatography ki misalein hain.

book_ref.quote: Examples of partition chromatography are paper chromatography and gas liquid chromatography.

blocks.prompt:
57 In paper chromatography, the stationary phase is the:
(Paper chromatography mein stationary phase kya hai?)

options.text: organic solvent moving over the paper
water entrapped in the cellulose fibres of the paper

blocks.explanation: Paper ke cellulose fibres mein phansa paani stationary phase hai; us se na milne wala organic liquid mobile phase hai.

book_ref.quote: The entrapped water in cellulose fibers of paper and mobile phase which passes over the paper are immiscible

blocks.prompt:
58 The mobile phase in paper chromatography is usually:
(Paper chromatography mein mobile phase aam tor par kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mobile phase aam tor par organic liquid hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The mobile phase is usually an organic liquid.

blocks.prompt:
59 In ascending paper chromatography the solvent moves up the paper by:
(Ascending paper chromatography mein solvent paper par upar kaise charhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ascending qisam mein solvent capillary action (bareek naaliyon ka amal) se upar charhta hai.

book_ref.quote: In this technique, the solvent travels upwards by capillary action.

blocks.prompt:
60 On the strip of chromatographic paper, the thin pencil line for the sample spot is drawn about:
(Chromatographic paper ki patti par sample spot ki pencil line kitne faasle par lagti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 20 cm patti par aik sire se taqreeban 2.5 cm par patli pencil line lagai jati hai.

book_ref.quote: draw on it a thin pencil line about 2.5 cm from one end

blocks.prompt:
61 Spots of known compounds are placed alongside the sample on the pencil line to:
(Sample ke saath pencil line par maloom compounds ke spots kyun lagaye jate hain?)

options.text: help identify the components of the mixture

blocks.explanation: Maloom compounds ke spots mixture ke ajza ki pehchaan mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: spots of the known compounds may also be placed alongside

blocks.prompt:
62 The spotted end of the paper is dipped into the solvent mixture to a depth of about:
(Spot wala sira solvent mixture mein kitni gehraai tak dubaaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spot wala sira 5-6 mm tak solvent mein dubaaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: dips into solvent mixture to a depth of 5-6 mm

blocks.prompt:
63 As the solvent front passes the spots on the paper, the components of the solute:
(Jab solvent front paper par spots se guzarta hai to solute ke ajza kya karte hain?)

options.text: all move at the same rate

blocks.explanation: Solvent front guzarne par mukhtalif ajza mukhtalif raftaar se chalte hain aur alag ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Different components of solute will move at different rates.

blocks.prompt:
64 When the solvent front has risen far enough, the strip is removed and:
(Solvent front kaafi upar charh jane par patti nikaal kar kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: the strip is washed with water
the solvent front is marked with a pencil and the strip is dried
the spots are cut out at once

blocks.explanation: Patti nikaal kar pencil se solvent front ka nishaan lagaate aur sukhaate hain.

book_ref.quote: remove the strip, mark the solvent front with a pencil and allow the strip to dry

blocks.prompt:
65 The pattern on the dried paper after paper chromatography is called a:
(Paper chromatography ke baad sookhe paper par bane naqsh ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sookhe paper par bana naqsh chromatogram kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: Once the paper is dried, the pattern on the paper is called a chromatogram.

blocks.prompt:
66 A very convenient way of seeing a colourless chromatogram is to:
(Berang chromatogram dekhne ka bohat aasaan tareeqa kya hai?)

options.text: view it under UV lamp light
fold it into a fluted paper

blocks.explanation: UV light mein berang chromatogram ke spots rangdaar nazar aate hain.

book_ref.quote: A very convenient way of visualizing the colourless chromatogram is to see it under the light of a UV lamp.

blocks.prompt:
67 Which is named in the chapter as a locating agent?
(Chapter mein kis cheez ko locating agent bataya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ninhydrin jaisa locating agent spots dhoondne ke liye istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: a locating agent like ninhydrin can be used

blocks.prompt:
68 A locating agent such as ninhydrin reacts with colourless substances like ____ to give coloured products.
(Ninhydrin jaisa locating agent kin berang substances se react kar ke rangdaar products banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Locating agent berang substances (maslan amino acids) se react kar ke rangdaar products banata hai.

book_ref.quote: reacts with the colourless substances like amino acids to give coloured products

blocks.prompt:
69 The Rf value of a component is the ratio of the distance travelled by:
(Kisi component ki Rf value kis nisbat (ratio) ko kehte hain?)

options.text: the component to the distance travelled by the solvent, both from the original spot
the solvent to the distance travelled by the component
